ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that segment $AB=20$, $C$ is a point on segment $AB$, $D$ is a point on $CB$, $E$ is the midpoint of $DB$, and $DE=3$. If $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$, what is the length of $CD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $C$ is the midpoint of $AB$, and $AB=20$,

$\therefore$ $AC=CB=10$. Given also that $DB=6$,

$\therefore$ $CD=CB-DB=10-6=\boxed{4}$.
